Definition: Imri, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Imri is the name of two men, a man of Judah and the father of a builder. In 1 Chronicles 9:4 Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, dwells in Jerusalem after the return, and in Nehemiah 3:2 the men of Jericho build beside Zaccur the son of Imri.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Imri's name is carried by his sons: one dwells in Jerusalem, and one builds the wall, and the father's name lives in the work they did.
